item.title: Log a workout, symptom or medicine with just what you know
item.summary: Tell Murph "went rowing this morning" or "took my allergy pill" and it logs it, without first asking how long, how bad or how much.
item.details: Murph saves the details you give and leaves the rest out, never guessing a number. Add a duration, a 0 to 10 score or a dose any time you want it tracked.
